summary: postinstall installs an undeclared sibling package from the registry
details: package.json declares a postinstall hook that changes directory out of the package's own tree (`cd../..`) and runs `npm i randompkgb`, forcing installation of a package that is not listed in this package's dependencies. On `npm install randompkga`, npm automatically runs the hook, which fetches `randompkgb` unpinned from the registry and executes whatever code that package ships, including its own lifecycle scripts. The mechanism smuggles an undeclared dependency into the installer's node_modules and gives whoever controls the `randompkgb` name arbitrary code execution at install time, bypassing normal dependency review and lockfile pinning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
